item.title: Dance, music and play drive Star Academy’s new occasional care program for preschoolers
item.description: Little Stars Creative Care at Star Academy Adelaide offers performing-arts-based occasional care for children aged 2–5, supporting confidence, creativity and school readiness.

item.title: New research shows rare mammals thriving in SA’s west coast island safe havens
item.description: New surveys reveal vulnerable native mammals are thriving on remote west coast islands, highlighting the crucial role protected habitats play in safeguarding South Australia’s biodiversity.

item.title: Tilley Recreation Park unveils grand plans for brand-new dog park in Surrey Downs for pooches of all sizes
item.description: The City of Tea Tree Gully has big plans for the Tilley Recreation Park upgrade, including a brand-spanking new dog park with separate (and fully fenced!) areas for small and large dogs.

item.description: A South Australian wine producer is heading sky-high, with four wines selected for the Qantas inflight wine program.

item.description: The Donkey Discovery Experience is the latest wildlife encounter thats a must-do this summer.

item.description: Prohibition Liquor Co has unveiled The Speakeasy, complete with velvet lounges, a dedicated bartender and moody winter-ready vibes.

item.title: Labor unveils plan for Greater Northern Adelaide Hospital at Concordia site
item.description: The State Government has secured a nine-hectare site in Concordia for a proposed Greater Northern Adelaide Hospital, set to service Adelaide’s northern suburbs and the Barossa Valley.

item.title: Adelaide tourism leader Journey Beyond grows with SeaLink acquisition deal
item.description: Journey Beyond has entered an agreement to acquire SeaLink’s tourism portfolio, expanding its reach across cruises, resorts and sightseeing experiences nationwide while strengthening South Australia’s tourism offering.

item.title: Severe weather warning issued for Adelaide as damaging winds loom overnight
item.description: A Severe Weather Warning has been issued for Adelaide and the Mount Lofty Ranges, with damaging wind gusts above 90km/h possible tonight and early Wednesday morning.
